messages.subject: Can CODEX be used for samples without controls, how to compare CNV results of CODEX from two sample sets with different exomes captured?
messages.subject_clean: Can CODEX be used for samples without controls, how to compare CNV results of CODEX from two sample sets with different exomes captured?
messages.body_plain:
Hi Yuchao,

I have two samples sets with different exomes captured (5000 exons vs. 26000 exons.).  All samples are from cases, and I don't have any controls.
So, I'm wondering, can CODEX be used in this case?
Is there any notes that need to pay attention when comparing CODEX results from two sets?

Thanks for your input in advance.

Sincerely,

Caiyun Zhu

messages.body_plain:
Hi Caiyun,

You need to process these two different sets separately by CODEX (and make sure if each set has around 30 samples). If you want to cross compare, I would recommend focus on the exons that are shared between the two sets.

Hope this helps,
Yuchao

messages.subject: Error in CODEX2 (negative widths are not allowed)
messages.subject_clean: Error in CODEX2 (negative widths are not allowed)
messages.body_plain:
Hi YuChao,

I am using CODEX2 to detect CNV for my WES data without normal controls.

I wrote a loop to call CNV for chromosomes, one by one successively (1...22,X,Y).  The program worked with chr1 and chr2, but something weird just happened when run getcoverage() for chr3.  The detailed information is as below.

> >   coverageObj <- getcoverage(bambedObj, mapqthres = 20)
> Error in .Call2("solve_user_SEW0", start, end, width, PACKAGE = "IRanges") :
>   solving row 1: negative widths are not allowed
> Calls: getcoverage ... RangesList -> IRanges -> solveUserSEW0 -> .Call2 -> .Call

I tried to output the bambedObj$ref to check the width, and found all values of width are >=2.  File chr3_ref was attached.

For now, I have no idea about how to fix it.  The Rscript CODEX2.R was also attached for your convenience.

Thanks a lot for your time. Have a good day.

Sincerely,

Caiyun

messages.subject: Re: Error in CODEX2 (negative widths are not allowed)
messages.subject_clean: Error in CODEX2 (negative widths are not allowed)
messages.body_plain:
Sorry for inconvience, I find the mistake after ...nearl 6 hours.  The bedFile.bed should be sorted by start and end positions, take care of the info author mentioned!

1. Seeking the source code of getcoverage.R (https://rdrr.io/bioc/CODEX/src/R/getcoverage.R).
    st <- start <https://rdrr.io/r/stats/start.html>(ref)[1]  #the first start pos of $ref
    ed <- end <https://rdrr.io/r/stats/start.html>(ref)[length <https://rdrr.io/r/base/length.html>(ref)]  #the last end pos of $ref
     .......
    IRanges(st - 10000, ed + 10000))  #if the st-10000 < ed + 10000, the error will occur.

2. Sort the bedFile.bed and run all chromosomes again.

Hope it will save other's time.

cc
